output.summary: The packet addresses the core concern regarding ownership and distribution rights. Section 9.1 confirms the Buyer owns 100% of custom deliverables (Foreground Work Product). Section 9.3 addresses the Vendor's background IP, granting the Buyer a perpetual, worldwide, paid-up, transferable license with full rights to distribute and sublicense to external clients. This aligns with the user's goal of a white-labeled, sublicensable product.
key_claims: Buyer owns 100% of custom deliverables (Foreground Work Product).
Vendor grants Buyer a perpetual, worldwide, paid-up, transferable license for Background Technology.
The license explicitly includes full rights to distribute and sublicense to Buyer's external clients.
